text: Hear now a tale! One ordinary evening, the Mess King moved into your home. Nobody invited him. He brought laundry.
But every home has a hero. In the hall closet, beneath three coats and a lost umbrella, a weapon lay waiting. For you.
Three lairs! Three bosses! One very messy kingdom. Win them back, and the Mess King shall have nowhere left to sit.
Welcome, hero. Your quest begins in the Laundry Lair. Probably.
The machine is finished. Back to the quest.
Level cleared. Take a breath. Then the next one.
Now then. Who are you, hero? Choose your champion, and tell me your name.
Behold, your kingdom! Three lairs, held by the Mess King and his crew. Choose where to strike.
Back at the map. The Mess King grows nervous. Choose your next lair.
The throne room stands open! The Mess King awaits. He is pretending not to be nervous.
Onward, through the village, to the Laundry Lair! The villagers cheer. They are running low on clean socks.
Onward to the Sink Caverns! The villagers cheer. They have been eating off napkins for days.
Onward to the Clutter Keep! The villagers cheer, from a safe distance.
The road to the throne! The whole village has come out to watch. No pressure.
The Laundry Lair. The Sock Skeletons guard every load, and the Laundry Lich waits in the last one. It has been waiting a while. It is fine with that.
The Laundry Lair is yours. Well done.
Gather the load. Grab everything for this load and bring it to the washer. Check under the bed. The skeletons hide socks there.
Sort it. Lights in one pile, darks in another, anything delicate on its own. Empty the pockets.
Start the washer. Load it, add detergent, press start. Then start the timer here and go do something else.
Into the dryer. Move it all to the dryer. Hang anything that should not be dried. Start the timer.
Fold it. Fold one item, land one hit. Count the load first.
Put it all away. Every folded item goes back where it lives. Drawers, hangers, the lot.
Boss, Fold the Lich. Fold one item, land one hit. Count the load first.
The Laundry Lair is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 1 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Laundry Lair is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 2 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Laundry Lair is free. All three lairs are free. The Mess King has run out of places to hide. The throne room is open, hero.
The home is yours. The Mess King packed one small bag and left. He will be back; he always is. But tonight, hero, every room is yours. Well played.
The Sink Caverns. Grease Gremlins guard the counters, and the Sink Warlord lurks under the suds. It has one axe and no manners.
The Sink Caverns is yours. Well done.
Clear the table. Bring every plate, cup and pan to the sink. Do not forget the mug by the couch.
Scrape and rinse. Scrape the leftovers into the bin and give everything a quick rinse. Run the water hot.
Wash up. Wash one dish (or load it in the dishwasher), land one hit.
Dry and put away. Dry what is clean and put it back in the cupboards. Running the dishwasher? Start it and tap done.
Wipe the counters. Wipe the counters and the sink. Wring out the sponge. Victory smells like lemon.
Boss, Wash the Warlord. Wash one dish (or load it in the dishwasher), land one hit.
The Sink Caverns is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 1 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Sink Caverns is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 2 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Sink Caverns is free. All three lairs are free. The Mess King has run out of places to hide. The throne room is open, hero.
The Clutter Keep. Every room is held by a Dust Brute, and the Clutter Colossus guards the last one. It is mostly cables.
The Clutter Keep is yours. Well done.
Grab your gear. Grab a bag for trash and a basket for things that live in other rooms.
Trash run. Bin everything that is trash, wrappers, receipts, the dried-out pen. Be ruthless.
Put things back. Put one thing back where it lives, land one hit.
Clear the surfaces. Clear the tables and shelves, straighten what is left, and take the basket where it goes.
Boss, Topple the Colossus. Put one thing back where it lives, land one hit.
The Clutter Keep is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 1 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Clutter Keep is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 2 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Clutter Keep is free. All three lairs are free. The Mess King has run out of places to hide. The throne room is open, hero.
The throne room. The Mess King sits on a pile of everything you ever meant to put away. He is not getting up. You will have to make him.
The Mess King's Throne is yours. Well done.
Sweep the Laundry Lair. Any clothes on the floor or the chair? Into the basket.
Check the Sink Caverns. Any dishes hiding in the sink? Wash them or load them.
Final Boss, The Mess King. Ten-minute reset, put one thing right anywhere in the home, land one hit.
Take the crown. Look around. Take a breath. This is your home again.
The Mess King's Throne is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 1 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Mess King's Throne is free. One less lair for the Mess King. 2 to go, hero. He is pretending not to notice.
The Mess King's Throne is free. All three lairs are free. The Mess King has run out of places to hide. The throne room is open, hero.

You have disturbed the Laundry Lich. It was napping on your chair.
The Lich flings a wet sock spell at you. Keep folding.
The Lich lunges. It smells faintly of fabric softener.
Critical. The Lich loses its hat. It pretends not to care.
Critical. A sock falls off. Nobody will ever find it.
The Lich restores its Ward. It found a matching sock. Smug.
Too slow. The Lich heals. It is now slightly more wrinkled.
The Lich is down to its last few threads.
The Laundry Lich is folded. It accepts this.
The Lich is defeated. The drawer is full. Peace returns.

The Sink Warlord raises its axe. It is mostly a fork.
The Warlord splashes dishwater at you. Keep scrubbing.
The Warlord swings a soggy axe at you. Rude.
Critical. The Warlord staggers into the dish rack.
Critical. The Warlord loses a plate. It squeaks.
The Warlord heals. A fresh coat of crusted lasagna.

The Warlord is running out of armor.
The Warlord is gurgling. That is not a good sign for it.

The Warlord is defeated. Every plate gleams.

The Clutter Colossus assembles itself. It is mostly cables.
The Clutter Colossus stands. It has been standing there for weeks. You just noticed.
The Colossus swings a mug at you. Keep tidying.
The Colossus throws a cable. It is tangled. Of course it is.
Critical. A chunk falls off the Colossus. It was a shoe.
Critical. The Colossus loses an arm made of mail.
The Colossus rebuilds. It found a box of old chargers.
Too slow. The Colossus heals. It has acquired a lamp.
The Colossus is barely a pile anymore.
The Clutter Colossus collapses into nothing. Everything is where it lives.
The Colossus is defeated. You can see the floor.
The Colossus is winding up. Finish an item to strike first.

The Mess King looks up from his throne. He sighs. He stands. He hates standing.
The Mess King yawns. You have his attention. Barely.
The Mess King flicks a crumb at you. It is a big crumb.
The Mess King points his plunger at you. Keep going.
Critical. The King sits up straight for once.
The Mess King reclines. The mess grows back a little.
Too slow. The King looks pleased with himself.
The Mess King is losing his throne.
The King looks around for somewhere else to sit.
The Mess King topples off his throne. Your home is yours again.
The Mess King is defeated. He leaves without saying goodbye. Typical.
